IMPORTANT INFORMATION
FOR OUR 727-214 FANJET PASSENGERS
Even though you may be an experienced air traveler, there are certain
features of this, the most modern of air transports, with which you may
not be familiar.
PACIFIC SOUTHWEST AIRLINES
AUTOMATIC OXYGEN SYSTEM
The higher altitudes at which this aircraft operates require the
prompt use of the automatic oxygen system in case of any
sudden change in cabin pressure. Should a decompression occur
oxygen masks will drop down. Take nearest mask and promptly
place over nose and mouth. Adjust Headband: Breathe normally.
NO SMOKING

EMERGENCY EXITS
There are nine exits provided for your use. The chart below will
show you the one closest to your seat. The exits over the wings
are removable windows. The two exits forward and the two side
exits aft are doors which are equipped with fast operating
evacuation slides.
